data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Payatas, Quezon City

In coordination with the Quezon City LGU and Barangay Payatas, Maynilad is continuing pipe replacement works along Soliven and Payatas Roads to improve water service reliability.

Please expect stop-and-go traffic in the areas listed below from October 28 to November 9, 2025 (10:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m.) while we continue our pipe-laying works.

• Soliven St. – Pipe laying (approx. 100 LM)
• Payatas cor. Kapalaran – Hydrotesting
• Payatas cor. Soliven – Temporary restoration
• Payatas Rd. – Permanent restoration (Nov. 7–9)

Thank you for your patience and cooperation. Traffic management assistance is being provided by the QC LGU.
